scope: Pinned private Moshi training/runtime environment only; not the general application environment.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi requires aiohttp>=3.10.5,<3.12; the available fixes begin outside that range.
mitigations: Do not expose the pinned training environment as a public service.
Bind any later research server to loopback or a trusted authenticated network only.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream Moshi migration.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi requires sentencepiece==0.2; the published fix is 0.2.1.
mitigations: Load only the SHA-256-pinned Moshika SentencePiece model.
Never parse participant-provided or other untrusted tokenizer model files.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream Moshi migration.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Pinned Moshi-Finetune requires torch==2.6 and pinned Moshi requires torch<2.7; fixes are outside the supported range or unavailable.
mitigations: Load only SHA-256-pinned safetensors and project-generated checkpoints; never torch.load untrusted files.
Use the isolated environment for local single-GPU research, not public multi-tenant inference.
Treat audio, captions, network messages, and model files from outside the frozen corpus as untrusted.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before deployment or an upstream trainer migration.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: certifi 2026.10.19 removes the emSign roots with compromised intermediate keys. requirements-moshi.lock records the exact environment of the completed Moshi experiments (recorded in results/hardware/moshi_environment.json); upgrading it would no longer reproduce those runs.
mitigations: The recorded runs load pinned, SHA-256-verified local checkpoints and make no network requests.
Do not download models or data with this environment; fetch them in the application environment and verify hashes.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before any reuse of the environment.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: The three advisories (Windows oplock and SQLite-backed ReadWriteLock races) are fixed in filelock 4.2.1. requirements-moshi.lock records the exact environment of the completed Moshi experiments (recorded in results/hardware/moshi_environment.json); upgrading it would no longer reproduce those runs.
mitigations: The environment runs on a Linux host under a single operator account with private cache directories.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before any reuse of the environment.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: Image-decoder advisories; Pillow 13.0.0 fixes the bundled libopenjp2 issue and several others list no fixed release yet. requirements-moshi.lock records the exact environment of the completed Moshi experiments (recorded in results/hardware/moshi_environment.json); upgrading it would no longer reproduce those runs.
mitigations: The Moshi pipeline processes audio and text only and never opens image files.
Do not open untrusted images in this environment.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before any reuse of the environment.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: A Windows-only path escape during legacy wheel installation, fixed in setuptools 84.1.0. requirements-moshi.lock records the exact environment of the completed Moshi experiments (recorded in results/hardware/moshi_environment.json); upgrading it would no longer reproduce those runs.
mitigations: The environment is installed once on Linux from the hash-pinned lock; no legacy wheels from untrusted sources are installed.
Re-evaluate and remove this exception before any reuse of the environment.
